Welcome to Seaboard Foods
Proudly American Owned. Purposefully Connected.
We celebrate America through our commitment to excellence—producing some of the world’s best pork and feeding people around the globe.
learn more about who we are
Welcome to Seaboard Foods
Proudly American Owned. Purposefully Connected.
Our commitment to excellence allows us to produce some of the world's best pork to feed people around the world.
learn more about who we are
America’s Birthday Is Best Celebrated in the Backyard
As an American-owned pork company, we’re marking this milestone by celebrating the moments that bring us together.
For 250 years, America has been built on everyday moments—neighbors stopping by, families firing up the grill and food that brings people together. This year, Prairie Fresh is celebrating America’s birthday by honoring the backyards where those moments happen.
learn more
Relentlessly Seeking a Better Way To Produce Wholesome Pork
Since the early 1990s, we’ve been building a uniquely connected food system, linking each step of the process from before the farm to tables across the globe– we call it The Prairie Fresh Way. We strive for the highest levels of innovation, continuous improvement, and quality in everything we do.
We Are Committed To:
Our Employees

In Our Communities
Our hometown roots run deep. That's why Seaboard Foods extends our commitment to excellence to our local communities – offering support and giving back to the places we call home.
learn more about our commitment to community
In Our Communities
Our hometown roots run deep. That's why Seaboard Foods extends our commitment to excellence to our local communities – offering support and giving back to the places we call home.
learn more about our commitment to community
We are committed to serving our hometowns by doing our part to support local schools, charities and organizations. From feeding first responders to supporting local education, we contribute to the hometowns where our employees live, play and work.
We contribute our time and resources to build stronger communities where we operate. We sponsor cultural and fundraising events and our employees volunteer to help our communities thrive.
Seaboard Foods supports Operation BBQ Relief in its mission to serve warm, nutritious and delicious pork meals to disaster-affected communities, offering solace to residents, first responders, and relief workers.
